text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no specific antidote for mesalamine overdose and treatment for suspected acute severe toxicity with mesalamine should be symptomatic and supportive. This may include prevention of further gastrointestinal tract absorption, correction of fluid electrolyte imbalance, and maintenance of adequate renal function. Mesalamine delayed-release capsules are a pH dependent delayed-release product and this factor should be considered when treating a suspected overdose.
